en.title: Willi Carlisle – “Marlboro Vinyasa”
en.summary: "I been gettin' up each morning with the hair of the downward dog." That fantastic lyric belongs to "Marlboro Vinyasa," the latest single from Willi Carlisle's Tyler Childers-produced double album The Universal Bubba. Unlike prior single "Mason Jar At The Center Of The World," which was the kind of a traditional reel you could squaredance to, this song is a barroom country-rocker.

en.title: Resavoir Announce New Album Above The Clouds: Hear “4th Cloud” (Feat. Gregory Uhlmann)
en.summary: Trumpeter Will Miller has been a fixture of Chicago's music scene for years, appearing on key 2010s releases from artists like Chance The Rapper, Whitney, and Twin Peaks and branching out beyond the Windy City for work with heavy hitters like SZA and Mavis Staples. And for many years now, he's been leading Resavoir, an oft-morphing Chicago jazz ensemble that used to record for the city's esteemed International Anthem label.
